Du vil jobbe med noen av verdens største merkevarer og tett med publisister og teknologileverandører som Google, Schibsted, Spotify, YouTube, Aller og JCDecaux. Hvis du brenner for digital markedsføring, trives med å utforske nye muligheter og ønsker en arbeidshverdag som kombinerer utfordringer med masse sosial moro, er dette stillingen for deg! Her får du sjansen til å kickstarte karrieren din i et internasjonalt selskap i verdensklasse. Det er store muligheter for personlig vekst og utvikling, og flere av våre kollegaer har deltatt og faktisk også vunnet Young Media Lions i Cannes, som i praksis er VM i markedsføring! Stillingen er et 12-måneders vikariat. Om WPP Media WPP Media er medieenheten til WPP og består av merkevarene EssenceMediacom, Mindshare, Wavemaker og Choreograph. I en verden der media er overalt og i konstant endring, samler vi de beste menneskene, plattformene og partnerne for å skape ubegrensede muligheter for vekst. For mer informasjon, besøk nordics.wppmedia.com . Vi investerer stort i kultur, våre ansatte og teknologi for å være fremst i utviklingen og kunne levere fremragend

That means writing to spec, working directly with OEM and SOC engineering teams, and validating what partners ship back before Samba can use any of it. This is about as upstream as it gets: if the signal doesn't get captured off the device, there's no TV data downstream, and TV data is the base layer Samba's whole business is built on. Beyond the core ACR work, the team also powers mobile apps that use TV viewership data and an edge AI feature that recognizes video game titles and shoppable items showing up on screen. jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job. The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next. We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. We're judged on reliability, cost efficiency and how quickly we unblock users when something breaks. This backend role sits where open table formats, cloud data warehouses and processing engines meet.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer II - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next. These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide. This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

jobs.description_text: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spotify is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Authorization team within Platform. Our team builds and operates the authorization and permissioning systems that enable creators and their teams to securely access and manage their presence across Spotify. What began by supporting Spotify for Artists has grown into foundational capabilities used across Spotify, including Music, Podcasts, and Audiobooks. This is a backend-focused role working on systems that sit on a critical path for Spotify's creator ecosystem. You'll help us evolve these systems as they grow in scale and complexity, bringing strong backend engineering expertise while collaborating across product, frontend, and data when needed.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Content Platform

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to provide architectural leadership across this media platform. You’ll help shape and drive the technical direction from ingestion through transcoding, packaging, storage, delivery, and playback. This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, understands the trade-offs between codec choices and infrastructure costs, and can drive technical strategy across multiple teams at scale.

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer - Agentic Experiences
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints, from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. Spotify's Core Experience (CoreX) team is shaping how listeners interact with Spotify through conversation, voice, and AI-powered experiences. We're building new ways for Premium subscribers to discover content, create playlists, control playback, and explore what they're listening to, using natural language. We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to help shape the future of these experiences. You'll lead the design direction for our conversational agent while staying close to the craft, designing and prototyping experiences that make AI feel useful, intuitive, and trustworthy. Working with product, engineering, machine learning, and design partners, you'll help create experiences that bring listeners closer to the audio and creators they love.

jobs.title: Customer Success Operations Specialist
jobs.description_text: This role sits at the center of how Traackr customers get help and get their data. You will work closely with Customer Success Managers, the operations team, and our data and product partners, learning the product deeply enough to answer hard questions and spot the patterns behind them. Success looks like customers who get fast, accurate answers, integrations that land on time, and support processes that get measurably easier to run.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description_text: As a Software Engineer you will work closely with our engineering, product, and design teams to implement the future of our product and build amazing experiences for our customers. You'll be involved in the entire product development lifecycle including the design, development, deployment and maintenance of new and existing features. You'll write clean and functional code on the front- and back-end for our world-class customers. You enjoy being challenged, love learning, be detail-oriented, appreciate working with people from diverse backgrounds, and be really passionate about what you do. jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Advanced Product and Solutions Lead will play a key role in technical customer engagements by managing product customization requests and elaborating detailed technical content, across both commercial and defense segments. The role sits within the Product Management organization for Telesat Lightspeed and works closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Sales, Customer Solutions, Operations and ecosystem partners. The role will work across the range of products and solutions offered by Lightspeed, including connectivity services, value-added services, security services, private infrastructure offerings, user terminals, and third-party integrations. jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are seeking a highly motivated and collaborative professional to support the cybersecurity compliance activities of the Telesat Lightspeed program. The successful candidate will be responsible for assessing and monitoring the implementation of cybersecurity controls across Lightspeed systems and processes, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory, contractual, and certification requirements. This role will work closely with Engineering, Operations, IT, and business stakeholders to obtain evidence of control implementation, track remediation activities, identify compliance gaps, and provide ongoing assurance of cybersecurity readiness. The candidate will play a key role in coordinating compliance initiatives, maintaining program visibility, supporting assessments and audits, and helping ensure continued readiness for frameworks and certifications such as CMMC, IA-Pre, and other applicable industry standards.

jobs.title: Document Control Coordinator
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Telesat LEO Lightspeed Document Control Coordinator will report to the Lightspeed Manager, Configuration Management & Change Control. The Document Control Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting mission assurance and program execution within Lightspeed Program. This position is responsible for the controlled management of technical and program documentation throughout its lifecycle, ensuring compliance with aerospace quality standards, configuration management principles, and customer/mission requirements. The Document Control Coordinator will require a good working knowledge of document and data management control processes and procedures with experience working with best practices standards such as CM2, ANSI-EIA 649, or ISO 10007 on complex, large to medium sized systems integration projects. The Document Control Coordinator will also require excellent organizational, language, writing and communication skills with intermediate to advanced proficiency using MS Office products (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint). The role ensures that all documentation is accurate, traceable, audit-ready, and aligned with program baselines, supporting the successful delivery of high-reliability, mission-critical space systems.

jobs.title: Facilities Technician / Technicien(ne) des installations
jobs.description_text: Télésat (Nasdaq et TSX : TSAT) est un opérateur mondial de satellites de premier plan qui fournit depuis plus de 50 ans des solutions de communication par satellite fiables et sécurisées à des clients du secteur de la radiodiffusion, des télécommunications, des entreprises et des gouvernements. The successful candidate will provide subject matter expertise in strategic sourcing, contract management, supplier governance, and risk mitigation. Working closely with engineering, program management, finance, legal, and commercial stakeholders, this individual will ensure supplier contracts are effectively negotiated, executed, administered, and monitored while meeting corporate, program, and contractual obligations. This role will play a key part in supporting defence, aerospace, government, and technology-related procurement initiatives while ensuring compliance with corporate policies, contractual obligations, and industry best practices. jobs.title: Manager, Release Management and QA
jobs.description_text: Reporting to the Director, Service Management, the successful candidate will provide technical and team leadership for the testing, quality assurance, release management, and production operations of Lightspeed business and technical applications and platforms. The candidate will be responsible for monitoring and ensuring high software quality standards throughout the systems development lifecycle and for supporting the operation of Telesat's Lightspeed production and test environments. Working closely with the Platform Engineering, Development, and IT PMO teams, the candidate will help plan, coordinate, and execute testing and production release activities while ensuring alignment with project schedules and operational requirements. The successful candidate will develop and maintain performance metrics, analyze results and trends, and present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders to support informed decision-making and continuous improvement. Candidates must reside in the Ottawa area or be willing to relocate. Relocation assistance will be provided to qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Manager, Revenue and Receivables
jobs.description_text: Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators. Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world. The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Manager, Revenue and Receivables is responsible for overseeing the revenue accounting and billing functions for Telesat and its subsidiaries, credit and collections for the Consolidated group of companies, and implementation and maintenance of revenue reporting and related controls.

jobs.title: Satellite Operations Engineer (GEO)

jobs.title: Senior Director, Canada Defence — Client & Program (ESCPP)
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are looking for an exceptional Senior Director to be the single face of this program from Telesat to DND – owning the customer relationship and orchestrating delivery from build through to operational service. This is as much a technical and program-delivery leadership role as it is a customer role: you will bring genuine engineering fluency and deep program management discipline to steer a complex, multi-segment space and ground system from build through to in-service operation.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Delivery Lead
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Senior Engineering Delivery Manager is responsible for driving integrated engineering execution across the Core User Terminal (Core UT) platform. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Program Management Office
jobs.description_text: The Senior Manager, Project Management Office (PMO) reports to the Director of Mission Assurance and Program Integration and is responsible for leading enterprise program governance, integrated schedule and budget planning, program controls, portfolio reporting, and cross-segment coordination for complex telecommunications and space programs. This role provides the framework, tools, processes, and oversight necessary to enable successful program delivery across multiple organizational segments while ensuring executive leadership has clear visibility into program performance, risks, dependencies, milestones, and strategic objectives. The Senior Manager, PMO has a staff who serve as the central integrators across engineering, operations, supply chain, finance, mission assurance, product management, and other stakeholder organizations supporting multiple projects. The position does not directly manage segment Program Managers, who remain within their respective organizations and coordinate extensively with the PMO, However, the role establishes program management standards, methodologies, reporting requirements, and governance practices across the enterprise. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating in an evolving environment where not all processes, standards, and organizational interfaces have been fully established, and where success requires building structure, alignment, and operational discipline across multiple stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Network Management Software Developer

jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com As a Senior NMS Software Developer, you will lead the design, development, and evolution of Lightspeed's Network Management and OSS platforms, enabling service fulfillment, assurance, automation, and observability across a carrier-grade LEO satellite network. jobs.title: Senior Trainer, Instructional Design & Training
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Senior Trainer, Instructional Design & Training to join our team, reporting directly to the GTM PMO & Business Operations Head. In this senior role, you will lead the design, development, and delivery of high-quality training programs and enablement materials for Telesat’s Business Support System (BSS) and the Canadian Department of National Defence (DND) customer under the Enhanced Satellite Communication Project (ESCP) — a major contract award. You will be accountable for the full training deliverable set, spanning the BSS, LEO Mission and Network Operations training and User Terminal (UT) operations and field maintenance training, translating complex technical content into structured, self-paced, and instructor-led curricula that meet Canada’s accessibility, format, and Learning Management System requirements. If you are a proactive learning professional with a passion for building operational readiness and a proven track record delivering training in demanding, mission-critical defence environments, we encourage you to apply and help us achieve our strategic goals.

jobs.title: Senior User Terminal System Engineer

jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect with deep expertise in Business Support Systems (BSS), Enterprise Data Platforms, Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence solutions. jobs.title: TCC Technologist

The TCC technologist proactively monitors network services and fixed satellite service customers, and manages the troubleshooting and investigation of reported faults until services have been restored. They perform hands-on corrective and preventative measures to Allan Park earth station critical systems, TT&C ground communications equipment, and on-site customer services.

jobs.title: Technical Program Integration Lead
jobs.description_text: The Technical Program Integration Lead serves as the focal point for integrated planning and execution within a major program segment, product area, or technical domain This role bridges technical complexity and program execution by transforming multiple engineering, product, software, hardware, operations, integration, and supplier workstreams into a cohesive, executable, and measurable program plan. Working across technical teams, systems engineering, program management, and program controls organizations, the Senior Technical Program Integration Lead ensures scope, dependencies, risks, readiness criteria, and delivery commitments are accurately represented within the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and broader program framework Unlike a traditional Project Manager or Integrated Program Controls Analysts, this role drives technical planning maturity, cross-functional alignment, and execution discipline while ensuring technical teams operate as a fully integrated part of the overall program The role is accountable for establishing and maintaining a credible, integrated execution plan, identifying, and proposing workarounds and mitigations for risks and dependencies early, and enabling leadership to make informed decisions based on clear assessments of program readiness and execution health Success in this position requires strong technical acumen, systems-level thinking, and the ability to influence diverse stakeholders toward a common execution strategy

The role will help refine documentation standards, improve document quality, manage document reviews, and ensure requirements traceability across the UT product portfolio.

jobs.title: User Terminal Program Manager, Mil-Ka
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: As User Terminal (UT) Program Manager, Mil-Ka, this position will join the User Terminal development team responsible for the development, integration, qualification, delivery, and deployment of Mil-Ka user terminal solutions supporting Telesat Lightspeed government and defence programs. This role requires a seasoned program manager with demonstrated experience managing complex satellite communications or similar hardware/software development programs through design, integration, verification, manufacturing readiness, delivery, and deployment. Experience developing satellite communications equipment or user terminals for government, defence, or other mission-critical applications is highly desirable. Success in this role requires a proactive, results-driven program manager with a high degree of initiative and strong communication skills, able to drive execution across cross-functional organizations and external suppliers while operating effectively in a complex government program environment.

jobs.description_text: ウーブン・バイ・トヨタについて ウーブン・バイ・トヨタは、トヨタの100年に一度のモビリティ・カンパニーへの変革に寄与していきます。「自分以外の誰かのために」発明を続けたという歴史からインスピレーションを受けた私たちのミッションーそれは、モビリティの定義を拡げ、そしてモビリティが社会に貢献する方法を拡張し、人を想うイノベーションで、モビリティの常識に挑み続けることです。 私たちは4つの柱を中心に活動しています：自動運転・先進運転支援システム技術のAD/ADAS、SDV（ソフトウェア定義車両）のための車両ソフトウェア生産プラットフォームであるArene、モビリティのテストコースであるWoven City、そして協業基盤を支えるデジタル・インフラストラクチャのCloud & AIです。また、ビジネスに不可欠な機能がこれらのチームの実装を下支えし、一丸となって「事故ゼロ社会」と「幸せの量産」の実現に向けて取り組んでいます。 ========================================================================= チームについて Teammate Driving (POV BEV) チームは、自動運転システムにおける最も基本的な機能の1つである車線維持機能と、自動運転システムで使用される地図情報提供サービスを開発しています。テストエンジニアのミッションは、システム要件に基づいて実装されたソフトウェアの機能、性能、品質基準を設定し、評価し、設計者にフィードバックし、製品の性能と品質を向上させることです。また、これらの製品をトヨタの次世代運転支援システム「Toyota Safety Sense」と「Teammate」に実装し、世界中の顧客により安全な運転とより快適なモビリティを提供します。 求める人材 私たちは、ソフトウェアのパフォーマンスと品質を向上させるために、AD/ADAS車両評価の運用と問題分析を行い、問題解決を推進できるエンジニアを探しています。また、ソフトウェアエンジニア、テストドライバ、さまざまな協力者と良好な関係を築くために、新しい価値を提案し、効果的にコミュニケーションできる人材を求めています。尚、定期的に東京・日本橋のオフィスに出社し、静岡県東富士のテストコースで実地試験の実施が必要となります。 業務内容 プロジェクトの進捗状況に合わせた評価計画の策定と管理 システム要件を満たすテストシナリオの作成 実車でのテストと特定された問題の原因の特定 アジャイル開発における問題管理と解決の推進 必須条件 以下のスキルと経験が必要です。 ・技術 ・車両評価業務 ・ユーザー視点でソフトウェア要件が満たされていることを検証する能力 ・Gitによるソフトウェア管理能力 ・AD（自動運転）/ADAS（先進運転支援システム）に関する知識と各技術の相互作用の理解 ・管理 ・優れた問題解決能力、仮説検証能力、タスク管理能力 ・ドキュメンテーション能力 ・さまざまな情報を体系化し、首尾一貫した計画を立案する能力 ・言語 ・日常的な場面で使われる日本語を理解できる能力。（例：日本語能力試験N2以上、または同等のレベル）

jobs.title: AI-First Engineering Intern
jobs.description_text: Why This Role Exists Xsolla is going all-in on becoming an AI-first company, and we're not waiting for a slow rollout to get there. We're offering AI Engineer Internships in regions across the globe to help drive that shift directly, not by sitting in the back office, but by building. You'll work on two things: Internal AI initiatives – helping unlock AI tooling and integrations across Xsolla faster than our existing teams can alone. Proof-of-concept builds on our own APIs – showing our product and engineering teams what's possible when you build with AI as a core part of your workflow, not an afterthought. This isn't a shadow-and-observe internship. You'll ship code that goes to customers – internal teams or external players and game developers – working closely with senior engineers and fellow interns across our global regions. Who You'll Work With You won't be isolated on an intern-only project island. You'll work closely with senior engineers who are actively rebuilding how we write software, and you'll be part of a global cohort of interns building in parallel across our regions. That combination is the point: senior engineers give you a bar for what production-grade, customer-facing code looks like, and your fellow interns give you a peer group to trade ideas, code, and AI workflows every week.

You will write the backend that sits between a partner and our commerce platform — link generation, click and conversion tracking, attribution pass-through, postbacks, and the reporting endpoints that feed partner payouts. You will also build the internal tooling that lets the Partnerships and Customer Success teams onboard partners and reconcile payouts without hand-editing spreadsheets. This is an entry-level engineering role with genuine product surface area. Recent graduates and career-changers with a strong project portfolio are welcome. If you like small, well-scoped systems that other people depend on daily, and you want to learn commerce, attribution, and payments engineering from a team that runs it at global scale, we would love to hear from you. About the Role We're looking for a Staff Engineer to own the smart wallet and account abstraction layer of Xsolla's Web3 platform. This is an individual contributor role with outsized technical scope: you'll be the technical anchor for how millions of players get an on-chain account they never have to think about — setting direction, making hard architectural calls, and raising the bar across the org. Concretely, you'll own the account model behind Xsolla ZK, our zkSync-based L2, and the wallet that sits inside Xsolla App. Every player who signs in with Xsolla ID receives a deterministic, non-custodial smart account — derived from their identity claim, identical on every device, with private keys that never leave the client. That account is not a separate "wallet" screen: it is the player's inventory, and it backs minting, gifting, trading on our Bazaar marketplace, Merkle-based reward airdrops, gas sponsorship, and an in-app dApp browser that exposes the same signer to third-party applications through an EIP-1193 provider. You'll own the primitives underneath all of it: the ERC-4337 user operation lifecycle, EIP-7702 delegation, session keys and origin-bound Smart Sessions, paymaster and gas abstraction strategy, and the custody and recovery roadmap — including the move from raw key export to MPC custody.
